            if arr[j] < arr[min]:
                min = j
            if arr[j] > arr[max]:
                max = j
        temp = arr[a]
        arr[a] = arr[min]
        arr[min] = temp
        if max == a:
            max = min
        temp = arr[b]
        arr[b] = arr[max]
        arr[max] = temp
        a += 1
        b -= 1

def ordenar(arr, a, b):
    if a >= b:
        return
    p = particionar(arr, a, b)
    ordenar(arr, a, p - 1)
    ordenar(arr, p + 1, b)


def particionar(arr, a, b):
    pivote = arr[a]
    i = a + 1
    j = b
    while i <= j:
        while i <= j and arr[i] < pivote:
            i += 1
        while i <= j and arr[j] > pivote:
            j -= 1
        if i <= j:
            temp = arr[i]
            arr[i] = arr[j]
            arr[j] = temp
            i += 1
            j -= 1
    temp = arr[a]
    arr[a] = arr[j]
    arr[j] = temp
    return j
